events.source_quote: During the three months ended March 31, 2022 , we completed the following ABS Notes transactions... Total $ 1,700 million

events.description: Payment of $1.4 billion for obligations related to accelerated clearing incentives for the C-Band spectrum acquired in Auction 107.
events.source_quote: In January 2022, we made additional payments of $ 1.4 billion for obligations related to accelerated clearing incentives

events.description: Agreements signed with satellite operators for early clearance of C-Band spectrum, with estimated costs of up to $340 million.
events.source_quote: In March 2022, Verizon signed agreements with satellite operators in which operators agreed to clear C-Band spectrum in certain markets and frequencies ahead of the previously expected December 2023 timeframe... Our estimated costs relating to these agreements could reach $340 million.

events.description: Payment of $94 million in severance benefits during the first quarter of 2022.
events.source_quote: During the three months ended March 31, 2022, we paid severance benefits of $ 94 million.

events.description: Establishment of a short-term uncommitted credit facility of up to $1.0 billion, and execution of $9.4 billion in commercial paper issuances and $5.6 billion in repayments.
events.source_quote: In March 2022, we entered into a short-term uncommitted credit facility with the ability to borrow up to $ 1.0 billion... we issued $ 9.4 billion in commercial paper and we repaid $ 5.6 billion of commercial paper.
